mutations.name: the sandbox lets the story navigate the console page
mutations.replace: export const LIVE_SANDBOX = "allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-top-navigation";
kills: a live story frame is sandboxed to scripts, its own origin and forms, with no permissions

mutations.name: a bridge message is trusted from any origin
kills: a live story frame swaps its PNG for the story on its own frame's ready, and ignores the same message from another window
keys pressed in a live story are ignored from a window that is not the story's frame

mutations.name: every section is live by default, Ship-bound ones too
kills: a live story frame in a Ship-bound section shows the approved PNG with Open live, and mounts no story until asked

mutations.name: a live frame's hit test takes the first box holding the point, the outermost
mutations.replace: hitTest: (x, y) => named.find((box) => x >= box.x && x < box.x + box.width && y >= box.y && y < box.y + box.height)?.target
kills: a live frame's pin surface hit-tests the innermost element that has a testId, in the frame's CSS px
a live story frame keeps the story live in pin mode, places a pin on the innermost named element, and draws held pins over the story

mutations.name: the page presses any key the story forwards (harness parity)
kills: keys pressed in a live story step through the round, but a digit never picks a choice
keys pressed in a live story never advance or send on a forwarded Enter, plain or held with Cmd
